description.en: A water fern combines branching rhizomes, roots, pinnate leaves and large sporocarps.
description.zh: 水蕨兼具分枝根茎、根、羽状叶及大孢子果。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Hydropteris pinnata; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Hydropteris pinnata 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Pinnate leaf blades with conspicuous sporocarps and rooted rhizomes differ from free-floating Azolla and Salvinia.
distinctness.zh: 具明显孢子果的羽状叶与生根根茎区别于自由漂浮满江红和槐叶萍。

modeling_brief.en: Use oval paired leaflets and compact ovoid sporocarps on a visible rhizome; keep fine roots simplified.
modeling_brief.zh: 以卵形对生小叶、紧凑卵形孢子果和可见根茎建形，简化细根。

uncertainty: Phylogenetic position is disputed; known organ combinations remain the basis.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: The role of Hydropteris pinnata in reconstructing the cladistics of heterosporous ferns
sources.supports: Pinnate aquatic fern with rhizomes, roots and sporocarps.
